name: Bizmark
long_description:
Hey YC! We're Bizmark. I (Rodrigo) grew up in a factory, watching my mum run everything through Excel and email.

That’s why we’ve built Otto, the OpenClaw for manufacturers.

In a few days, he learns from your systems and spreadsheets to take over repetitive work in procurement, quoting, and production planning. 

Otto is live at multiple factories, bringing in $108k in annual recurring revenue. Last month, he worked the equivalent of 9 full-time employees.

I did CS at UChicago and built a distribution business from 0 to $60M.

My cousin and cofounder Oscar did CS at Stanford and deployed AI for the US Air Force, Amazon, and the factories of Johnson & Johnson and Intel.

There's a quarter of a million manufacturers in the US, making this a $25B market.

In 5 years, they will all run on Otto-pilot.
